category.name: Feelings & Emotions
category.description: Perasaan, suasana hati, dan reaksi emosional.

words.definition: Worried or nervous about something.
words.example: I felt anxious before the interview.

words.definition: Feeling thankful for something.
words.example: I am grateful for your support.

words.definition: Annoyed because you cannot do what you want.
words.example: He was frustrated with the slow internet.
words.example_id: Dia frustrasi dengan internet yang lambat.

words.definition: Very happy and interested about something.
words.example: The kids are excited about the trip.

words.definition: Sad because you are alone.
words.example: She felt lonely in the new city.
words.example_id: Dia merasa kesepian di kota baru itu.

words.definition: Feeling sure about your own ability.
words.example: Practice made her more confident.

words.definition: Feeling unable to cope with too much.
words.example: I felt overwhelmed by the schedule.

words.definition: The good feeling when worry or pain stops.
words.example: It was a relief to finish the exam.

words.definition: Unhappy because someone has what you want.
words.example: Don't be jealous of other people's success.
words.example_id: Jangan cemburu pada kesuksesan orang lain.

words.definition: Peaceful and not worried.
words.example: Take a breath and stay calm.

words.definition: To respect or like someone very much.
words.example: I admire her patience.

words.definition: Slightly angry about something.
words.example: He was annoyed by the noise.

words.definition: Feeling bad about something you did.
words.example: She felt ashamed of her mistake.

words.definition: Feeling tired because nothing interests you.
words.example: The children were bored at home.

words.definition: Wanting to know or learn something.
words.example: She is curious about everything.

words.definition: Very pleased.
words.example: We are delighted to hear the news.
words.example_id: Kami senang sekali mendengar kabar itu.

words.definition: Sad because something was not as good as expected.
words.example: I was disappointed with the result.

words.definition: Feeling shy or awkward in front of others.
words.example: He was embarrassed to speak in public.
words.example_id: Dia malu berbicara di depan umum.

words.definition: Believing that something good may happen.
words.example: We are hopeful about the results.

words.definition: Annoyed, especially by something repeated.
words.example: She was irritated by the slow service.
words.example_id: Dia jengkel dengan layanan yang lambat.

words.definition: Worried and slightly afraid.
words.example: I get nervous before speaking.

words.definition: Happy about something you or others did.
words.example: Her parents are proud of her.

words.definition: Happy because something was good enough.
words.example: The customer was satisfied with the answer.

words.definition: Very surprised by something unexpected.
words.example: Everyone was shocked by the news.
words.example_id: Semua orang terkejut dengan kabar itu.

words.definition: Worried because of too much pressure.
words.example: She feels stressed before deadlines.

words.definition: Feeling that something unexpected happened.
words.example: I was surprised to see him here.

words.definition: Feeling of being sorry for someone's trouble.
words.example: She offered her sympathy to the family.
words.example_id: Dia menyampaikan simpatinya kepada keluarga itu.

words.definition: Unhappy or worried about something.
words.example: He was upset about the change of plan.

words.definition: To think about problems that may happen.
words.example: Don't worry about the test.

words.definition: To make someone feel less sad.
words.example: She comforted him after the bad news.
words.example_id: Dia menghiburnya setelah kabar buruk itu.

words.definition: A gentle feeling of liking or love.
words.example: She shows affection through small gestures.
words.example_id: Dia menunjukkan kasih sayang lewat hal-hal kecil.

words.definition: A strong feeling of being upset.
words.example: He hid his anger well.

words.definition: The ability to do something frightening.
words.example: It takes courage to speak up.

words.definition: A strong wish for something.
words.example: Her desire to learn never faded.
words.example_id: Keinginannya untuk belajar tak pernah pudar.

words.definition: Wanting what someone else has.
words.example: He felt envy when he saw the award.
words.example_id: Dia merasa iri saat melihat penghargaan itu.

words.definition: The feeling you get when in danger.
words.example: She has a fear of heights.

words.definition: The feeling of being thankful.
words.example: He wrote a letter of gratitude.

words.definition: A wish that something good will happen.
words.example: They never lost hope.

words.definition: The quality of being friendly and caring.
words.example: Thank you for your kindness.
words.example_id: Terima kasih atas kebaikan hati Anda.
